body_markdown:
Burke & Herbert Bank has named H.B. Swoope, V, Director of Private Banking, a leadership role focused on helping the Bank deliver its Private Banking services more effectively and efficiently across its six-state market footprint. The Bank first introduced Private Banking services in 2020 to serve the unique financial needs of high-net-worth clients. Private Banking is part of the Bank’s Wealth Management division, which includes investment services as well as trust and estate planning. Swoope will continue to report to Shannon Rowan, Executive Vice President and Head of Wealth Management.


“This enhanced focus on Private Banking represents an important opportunity to bring Burke & Herbert Bank’s highly personalized financial
expertise to more clients across our growing six-state footprint,” said Rowan. “H.B.’s deep understanding of the complex needs of high-net-worth clients makes him exceptionally well suited to this role. Under his leadership, we are well positioned to build deeper, more meaningful client relationships and bring Burke & Herbert Bank’s trusted Private Banking experience to new markets.”


Swoope brings more than two decades of banking and financial services experience, with deep expertise in serving clients and building relationships. In addition to his work in Private Banking, he has more than 10 years of experience focused on business development and customer relationship management. Swoope is a graduate of The Pennsylvania State University and a longtime Northern Virginia resident and former business owner.


“We have seen tremendous success and received positive feedback in our local market, and I look forward to offering our Private Banking services in more regions,” said Swoope. “Clients with complex financial needs benefit from specialized solutions and personalized guidance. In today’s evolving market, having a knowledgeable advisor committed to their long-term success is more important than ever.”


To learn more about Burke & Herbert Bank’s Private Banking services, requirements, and benefits, visit[https://www.burkeandherbertbank.com/wealth/private-banking/](https://www.burkeandherbertbank.com/wealth/private-banking/) .


Burke & Herbert Financial Services Corp. is the financial holding company for Burke & Herbert Bank & Trust Company. Burke & Herbert Bank & Trust Company is the oldest continuously operating bank under its original name headquartered in the greater Washington, D.C. metropolitan area. With nearly 100 branches across Delaware, Kentucky, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Virginia and West Virginia, Burke & Herbert Bank & Trust Company offers a full range of business and personal financial solutions designed to meet customers’ banking, borrowing, and investment needs. Learn more at[investor.burkeandherbertbank.com](https://investor.burkeandherbertbank.com/) .
